reports.concern: Complete contents and correct pattern at distribution
reports.claim: Assuming pattern exchanges reflect unclear envelope identity, S2:O7 implies distribution clarity matters alongside completeness, while S2:O2 shows contents alone remain unreliable.
assumptions: Unclear envelope identity caused the exchanges.

reports.concern: Shared material handling within time and space limits
reports.claim: Assuming crossed reaches interrupt picking, S2:O3 and S2:O4 suggest material access may contribute to omissions; distributing materials could also consume table area constrained by S2:C3.
assumptions: Distributed materials consume additional table area.

reports.concern: Comparison between the small batch and full session
reports.claim: Assuming pattern mixtures differ, S2:O4 cannot attribute its fewer omissions to loose materials; S2:O1 includes a separate check, further limiting direct speed comparison.
assumptions: The small-batch timing may exclude equivalent checking.

tension: Distribution evidence expands the valued outcome beyond contents; operational inference favours attention to material access under tight space limits; evidence interpretation withholds the comparative claim that supports that emphasis. No implication establishes which change would meet the deadline.
